en.joke: I spent 45 minutes scrolling through streaming options, then just looked at my phone.
en.explanation: It highlights the modern paradox of endless choices leading to inaction and reverting to simpler distractions, delivered with a deadpan observation.

people.name: Levi Eshkol
people.bio: Prime Minister of Israel from 1963 to 1969
people.extract: Levi Eshkol, born Levi Yitzhak Shkolnik, was the prime minister of Israel from 1963 until his death from a heart attack in 1969. A founder of the Israeli Labor Party, he served in numerous senior roles, including Minister of Defense (1963–1967) and Minister of Finance (1952–1963).
highlights: Founder of the Israeli Labor Party
Served as Minister of Defense and Finance

people.name: Louis Frederick I of Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt
people.extract: Louis Frederick I of Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt was the ruling prince of Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt, Count of Hohenstein, Lord of Rudolstadt, Blankenburg and Sondershausen from 1710 until his death.
highlights: Lord of Rudolstadt, Blankenburg and Sondershausen

people.name: Dave Simmonds
people.extract: Dave Simmonds was a British professional Grand Prix motorcycle road racer. He competed in the Grand Prix world championships from 1963 to 1972. Simmonds is notable for winning the 1969 125 cc FIM road racing world championship.
highlights: British Grand Prix motorcycle road racer
Competed in Grand Prix world championships (1963-1972)
